verses.html: A Song and Psalm for the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
verses.text: A Song and Psalm for the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
verses.title: A Song and Psalm for the sons of Korah.
verses.titleHtml: A Song and Psalm for the sons of Korah.

verses.html: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.text: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

verses.html: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
verses.text: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

verses.html: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
verses.text: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

verses.html: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
verses.text: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

verses.html: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.text: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

verses.html: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
verses.text: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

verses.html: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
verses.text: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

verses.html: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
verses.text: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

verses.html: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.text: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.html: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
verses.text: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

verses.html: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
verses.text: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

verses.html: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.
verses.text: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.

verses.html: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
verses.text: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
